body: This PR description is very verbose, could you try to make it a bit more succinct?

> This PR description is very verbose, could you try to make it a bit more succinct?

Yes, I understand what you mean. I was thinking about this while writing it too. This is already the final version, and it has been significantly shortened.

The reason I kept this level of detail is that reducing it further would remove important context. Either some technical facts would be lost, or the reasoning behind the chosen approach would become unclear.

This is not just a description of the changes; it is structured to explain why this solution was chosen and why the alternatives do not work. It should also prevent long discussions in the review by providing the full context upfront.

Sometimes issues simply require more explanation because they involve many details and constraints. I understand that not everyone has time to dive deeply into every topic, but for someone familiar with this area, the explanation should be straightforward.

---

Also, regarding the test, I did not understand why 1 did not pass. I do not really understand what exactly is being checked there, since it is very large. But it looks like an error in the script itself:
```
Unable to establish SSL connection
```
and
```
ERROR: Validate extension JSON: Error parsing '/tmp/tmp.DfCkDTls1P' at line 0: Unknown error getting token
   at: validate_extension_json_file (core/extension/extension_api_dump.cpp:1604)
```
My fix did not change anything like that, especially nothing critical.
